title: 737 MAX 10 Finally Clears the Runway, Trump's Beirut Dream Hits Turbulence, and BA Hunts Down Spy Glasses
summary: The 737 MAX 10 is about to get certified after six years of delays — but some airlines might not even want it. Plus, Trump wants direct flights to Lebanon restored for the first time since the 80s, but Beirut's airport has a safety problem money can't fix overnight, Mexico gets its US routes back, and British Airways is coming for your Meta smart glasses.
